brief.goal: Tighten standard-project authoritative readback to five absolute time points and make progress, plan state, and messages truthful.

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest, and project.state control-plane metadata
standard-project readonly executor, Node projection, Plan lifecycle, workbench presentation, and focused smoke tests
forbidden_actions: all real external platform calls and writes
all confirmation consumption and runtime workflow commands
database schema or workflow_case_summary View changes
new API routes, background jobs, browser persistence, sensitive or raw platform data
validation_plan: focused fake-transport readback schedule and lifecycle smoke
stop_conditions: a change requires a platform call, write, confirmation, or runtime job
a change requires a Schema, View, Gate, Plan/action type, public API, or background worker
the authoritative ID plus name readback condition would be weakened
